text:
jen (PM): Starting 01:00 UTC change window in ~1hr. Quick preflight: canary targets, pin decision, rollback thresholds. @deploy-bot please stand by to start the canary.

deploy-bot: Received. Will schedule canary start at 01:05 UTC when triggered. Suggested command: `/deploy canary --model model_v3.2.1-quant --traffic 2%`

sam (Backend): Image and model artifact pushed to registry. SHA: abc123def. Config ready in `deploy-config/canary.yaml`.

arjun (SRE): Quick SLOs for this rollout: p95 < 350ms, error_rate < 0.5%. I'll monitor latency, error spikes, and KV cache pressure.

maria (Infra): Infra check: no maintenance in region, autoscale cooldown = 120s. Recommend pinning scale policy to stable (no aggressive scale-outs) for the first 10m of canary.

jen (PM): Decision notes: pin model to `model_v3.2.1-quant` for the launch. Canary rollback triggers: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 > 500ms => immediate rollback. If error_rate between 0.25% and 0.5% -> throttle traffic back to 1% and investigate (no rollback yet).

deploy-bot: Executing canary now...

```
canary_start: 2026-03-20T01:05:24Z
model: model_v3.2.1-quant
traffic: 2%
status: running
logs: tailing -> /var/log/deploys/canary-2624001234.log
```

arjun (SRE): 01:12 UTC quick readout: p95 = 420ms (3-min window), error_rate = 0.15%. Latency is elevated but below hard threshold. Holding observation.

sam (Backend): Pushed a temporary config lock: `canary_stable_lock: true` in `deploy-config/locks.yaml` to prevent accidental parallel rollouts.

maria (Infra): Prepared region-cut playbook in case we need to isolate traffic: https://docs.internal/runbooks/region-cut. Also pre-created target group with warm instances.

jen (PM): Release notes draft: "Quantized model v3.2.1 — cost reduction, slight latency variance expected. Watch for generation drift on date-sensitive prompts." @maria can you push the notes to console under release tag `2026-03-20-quant`?

oncall-bot: Pager policy: non-critical alerts silenced for the 30m rollout window per `release-silence-2026-03-20`. Critical alerting unchanged.

jen (PM): Final ask: if metrics stable, ramp to 10% after a 20m steady window. Who wants the go for ramp?

arjun (SRE): I'll author a 20m observation checkpoint. Conditions to allow ramp: p95 < 350ms AND error_rate < 0.25% over 20m. If p95 in [350,500) or error_rate in [0.25,0.5) -> partial throttle to 1% and extended observation. If either > hard threshold -> rollback.

sam (Backend): Rollback command prepared: `/deploy rollback --to model_v3.2.0 --drain 30s --reason "canary rollback"`. I'll keep the terminal ready.

deploy-bot: Canary at 2% confirmed (01:05:24 UTC). Monitoring channels: #prod-metrics, #eng-sre. Auto-rollback hook: `auto-rollback=false` (human-in-loop). Webhook: https://hooks.internal/deploy-monitor/2624001234

jen (PM): Noted. Tagging changelog: `changelog/2026-03-20-quant-launch`. Pin expiration set to 72h (auto-unpin unless extended).

arjun (SRE): Acks. I'll update the incident template if we hit rollback and capture perf histograms.

sam (Backend): Ready for ramp when arjun gives green. On standby to execute rollback in <1m.

maria (Infra): I'll keep the scale policy pinned and monitor instance eviction events.

jen (PM): Thanks team — proceeding with quiet window at 01:00 UTC and watch party in #eng-releases. Will post final status at +30m. :rocket:

[thread end]
